meta.about: Negated search phrases (S12-017), round 4. The round-3 builder's 591 cases (labels kept, except the hyphenated words relabelled to the typed word), the round-3 rechecker's 511 (wave4-fix3-recheck3/search), and the recheck-3 findings' inputs plus new cases, each labelled from the query's structure before any version ran. strike/keep list titles the exclusion must and must not strike (checked with that version's own titleExcluded). Ambiguous cases are labelled on the safe side (strike less, take fewer words) and marked. No personal data.
meta.fields: expect is the right {positive, excluded}; alsoAccept lists answers that search the same; strike/keep are titles the exclusion must and must not strike, checked with the version's own titleExcluded, besides the generated pair per excluded phrase; main is origin/main's output; correct says whether each version answered the whole case right; gap (round 4 still wrong) says why and gapAnswer pins that answer. Every gap case is wrong on main too.
